request.spec:
Show the activity of the sheet: for every user and every event in the sheet's audit file, one
line <user> <EVENT> <count>, sorted by user then event.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Show the activity of the sheet: for every user and every event in the sheet's audit file, one
line <user> <EVENT> <count>, sorted by user then event.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I added an Activity panel to the sheet. Pressing **Show** (`activity-show`) lists one line `<user> <EVENT> <count>` (`activity-line`) for every user and event in the sheet's audit records, sorted by user then event. All 4 tests in `bin/e2e` pass.

**Backend:** a new read-only endpoint, `GET /api/sheets/{sheetId}/activity` (`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/sheets/{sheetId}/activity.GET.yml`). It reads the sheet's lines from the audit file and counts them by the `by=` user and the event name. It writes nothing to the store or the audit file. A line without a `by=` field is skipped. The code is `LoadActivity`, `RespondWithActivity` and the `Activity` record in `src/main/java/net/officefloor/hq/app/audit/`.

**Frontend:** `src/main/frontend/features/activity/activity.slot.tsx` places the panel right after the existing Audit viewer and works the same way. Pressing Show clears the old list before the new one appears, and a failed load shows `activity-error`.

Nothing in the stored data or schema needed to change, because the counts come straight from the audit file.
